Pafnuty.what: A Chebyshev harmonic generator: adds chosen harmonics.
Pafnuty.sound: Feeds on sine-like signals and adds the harmonics you pick, from second to thirteenth.
Pafnuty.use: Sound design and harmonic exciting. Not a normal filter.

Pafnuty2.what: Pafnuty with ten harmonics, fitted to the VCV Rack port.
Pafnuty2.sound: Chebyshev harmonic generation, a shorter version.

TakeCare.sound: Melt-style wobble with a Householder matrix of delays; dark and disconcerting, like The Caretaker.
TakeCare.use: Lush, unsettling chorus and ensemble textures.

controls.Derez: Undersampling for a darker, lo-fi tone.

RingModulator.sound: A polite sine multiplier from subsonic throbs to very high pitches; in stereo you get two modulators.

controls.Freq: Modulator frequency (two controls for the two channels).

Dubly3.what: A refined Dubly: noise-reduction style encode and decode.
Dubly3.sound: Tilt and shape controls over the Dubly seventies sound, with real compression instead of a transfer function.

Dubly2.what: A key part of seventies sonics, as a standalone.
Dubly2.sound: Encode and decode with tape-style saturation between.

Dubly.what: A retro vibe and atmosphere maker.
Dubly.sound: The noise-reduction trick turned into an effect: filter, compress 2:1 and add, then decode.

GalacticVibe.what: The stereo vibrato from the original Galactic reverb.
GalacticVibe.sound: A quadrature dual vibrato with a slightly irregular, organic LFO.

controls.Drift: Amount and speed of the drift.

CloudCoat.what: An array of blur effects with a taste for evil.
CloudCoat.sound: A bank of allpass blurs: smeared, bloom-like sound.

Disintegrate.sound: A delay-modulation distortion that disintegrates the sound, like a rocket launch heard from miles away.

controls.Top dB: The loudness (in air) at the point of clipping.
controls.Layers: Number of layers of the effect.

Fracture2.what: A West Coast wavefolder allowing more extreme disruption.
Fracture2.sound: Wavefolding with an exponential stage before folding.

controls.Drive: Overdrive into the folder. Unity at about 0.1.
controls.Fractre: Makes the signal go exponential before folding.

Fracture.sound: A sine-based West Coast wavefolder that wraps around up to a maximum fold, then clips.

controls.Fracture: How many times it folds before clipping.

PitchNasty.what: A primitive pitch shifter with time-stretch artefacts.
PitchNasty.sound: Mostly a punchy, tight pitch shift, otherwise loud sample glitches that become musical notes.

Trianglizer.what: A waveshaper that turns sines into triangles.
Trianglizer.sound: Triangle-ish waves from sines, plus fatness.

ShortBuss.what: Chases second harmonic, to add or remove it.
ShortBuss.sound: Finds asymmetry and amplifies it, or cancels it.

controls.ShortBs: How much second harmonic is chased.

GuitarConditioner.what: A Tube Screamer-like voicing without the squishiness.
GuitarConditioner.sound: Slew and highpass in parallel for a distinct tone quality.
GuitarConditioner.use: Conditioning a guitar sound. No controls.

Aura.what: A new kind of resonant lowpass EQ.
Aura.sound: Resonant lowpass colouring; more resonance as you go full wet.
Aura.use: Resonant tone shaping. Explore half-wet settings.

TremoSquare.what: A squarewave tremolo that only switches on zero crossings.

Tremolo.what: A tubey tremolo from fluctuating saturation curves.
Tremolo.sound: An organic, pulsating tremolo like classic records, not a volume animation.

GlitchShifter.what: A raw, gnarly pitch shifter with a dose of insanity.
GlitchShifter.sound: Equal-temperament or unquantized pitch shifting, with feedback and glitchy tracking.
GlitchShifter.use: Pitch shifting, doubling and glitch effects.

Gringer.what: A full-wave rectifier like a Green Ringer guitar effect.
Gringer.sound: Horrible unmusical noises, just like the original.

Exciter.what: An aural exciter that can be subtle or extreme.
Exciter.sound: Starts off sounding like nothing, then adds sparkle.
Exciter.use: Adding air and presence, as on Steely Dan records.

Energy2.what: Electrifying fixed-frequency treble boosts, for high sample rates.
Energy2.sound: Weird algorithm tied to sample rate; treble and high-mid aggression.
Energy2.use: Adding energy and aggression to the top end.

Energy.sound: A bizarre algorithm that acts like half a super-high-Q boost; the labels only relate to 44.1k.
Energy.use: Treble and high-mid boosts that normal EQ can't do.

Facet.what: A new kind of hard clip that adds two sharp corners.
Facet.sound: Changes the angle of the transfer function at a sharp point; peaks can still go beyond 0 dB.

controls.Facet: Position and amount of the corners.

PowerSag2.what: Improved circuit-starve plugin, now with inverse effect.
PowerSag2.sound: Power-supply sag with twice the range; the inverse hears what's taken away.
PowerSag2.use: Grungy, gatey sag and its opposite.

PowerSag.sound: The more output made, the less in reserve; doesn't distort directly.

Preponderant.what: Airwindows anti-Soothe: a tone intensifier and balancer.
Preponderant.sound: Three tightly controlled bands of emphasis, balanced on the fly so they stay active.
Preponderant.use: Hyping detail and sonority, the opposite of removing resonance.

Nikola.sound: Brighter and airier at low voltage; a disaster area at high voltage. It doesn't sound nice.

controls.Voltage: Voltage: airy and bright at low settings, midrangey and chaotic at high.
